contract_scope_note: Single independent technical review of a short comparative proposal and its finite demonstrations, not a multi-reader or transformative manuscript review. Scope/nonclaims appear explicitly throughout the reviewed source.

reasons: Independent reviewer read the entire frozen source and reported no mandatory corrections.
The 332 candidate finite distributions were independently reproduced. Separate QA checks examined 336 distributions and complete conditional transfer laws, not only their means.
Normalization, local observational equivalence, prior distinctions and interpretation limits are consistent with the stated proposal scope.
No inference, production engine, executable diagnostic protocol or external replication was approved.

owner_decisions_remaining: Choose whether to develop candidate D, or another alternative, under a new mathematical contract.
Approve the new contract, estimands and prospective precision criteria before experimental model implementation and estimation.
Preserve the original author model for external replication; a modified model cannot silently substitute for it.
scope: Accept the proposal as a source-bound decision document, without changing the literal benchmark or approving a fitted model.
